# `/roles` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /roles/v1/{roleId}/dimensions

`listDimensionsV1` — List dimensions

This API returns a list of dimensions under a specified role. A token with API, ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, or ROLE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call this API.

- Scopes: idn:role-checked:manage, idn:role-checked:read, idn:role-unchecked:manage, idn:role-unchecked:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `roleId` (path, required) — Parent Role Id of the dimension.
  - `for-subadmin` (query) — If provided, filters the returned list according to what is visible to the indicated ROLE_SUBADMIN Identity. The value of the parameter is either an Identity ID, or the special value **me**, which…
  - `limit` (query) — max 50 — default 50 — Note that for this API the maximum value for limit is 50. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in; name: eq, sw; created: gt, lt, ge, le; modified: gt, lt, ge, le; owner.id: eq, in — e.g. `id eq '2c918086749d78830174a1a40e121518'`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: name, created, modified — e.g. `name,-modified`
- Returns 200: array of dimension

### POST /roles/v1/{roleId}/dimensions

`createDimensionV1` — Create a dimension

This API creates a dimension. You must have a token with API, ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, or ROLE_SUBADMIN authority to call this API. Additionally, a ROLE_SUBADMIN cannot create a dimension that includes an access profile or entitlement if that access profile or entitlement is linked to a source that the ROLE_SUBADMIN is not associated with. The maximum supported length for the description field is 2000 characters.

- Scopes: idn:role-checked:manage, idn:role-unchecked:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `roleId` (path, required) — Parent Role Id of the dimension.
- Body (application/json): dimension
- Returns 201: dimension

### GET /roles/v1/{roleId}/dimensions/{dimensionId}

`getDimensionV1` — Get a dimension under role.

This API returns a Dimension by its ID. A token with API, ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, or ROLE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call this API. In addition, a token with ROLE_SUBADMIN authority may only call this API if all Access Profiles or Entitlements included in the Dimension or Parent Role are associated to Sources with management workgroups of which the ROLE_SUBADMIN is a member.

- Scopes: idn:role-checked:manage, idn:role-checked:read, idn:role-unchecked:manage, idn:role-unchecked:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `roleId` (path, required) — Parent Role Id of the dimension.
  - `dimensionId` (path, required) — Id of the Dimension
- Returns 200: dimension

### PATCH /roles/v1/{roleId}/dimensions/{dimensionId}

`patchDimensionV1` — Patch a specified dimension

This API updates an existing dimension using [JSON Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) syntax. The following fields are patchable: **name** **description** **owner** **accessProfiles** **entitlements** **membership** A token with API, ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, or ROLE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call this API. In addition, a token with ROLE_SUBADMIN authority may only call this API if all access profiles/entitlements included in the dimension are associated to Sources with…

- Scopes: idn:role-checked:manage, idn:role-unchecked:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `roleId` (path, required) — Parent Role Id of the dimension.
  - `dimensionId` (path, required) — Id of the Dimension
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: dimension

### DELETE /roles/v1/{roleId}/dimensions/{dimensionId}

`deleteDimensionV1` — Delete a dimension

This API deletes a Dimension by its ID. A token with API, ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, or ROLE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call this API. In addition, a token with ROLE_SUBADMIN authority may only call this API if all Access Profiles/Entitlements included in the Dimension are associated to Sources with management workgroups of which the ROLE_SUBADMIN is a member.

- Scopes: idn:role-checked:manage, idn:role-unchecked:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `roleId` (path, required) — Parent Role Id of the dimension.
  - `dimensionId` (path, required) — Id of the Dimension
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /roles/v1/{roleId}/dimensions/bulk-delete

`deleteBulkDimensionsV1` — Delete dimension(s)

This endpoint initiates a bulk deletion of one or more dimensions. When the request is successful, the endpoint returns the bulk delete's task result ID. To follow the task, you can use [Get Task Status by ID](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/get-task-status-v-1), which will return the task result's status and information. This endpoint can only bulk delete up to a limit of 50 roles per request. A token with API, ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, or ROLE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call…

- Scopes: idn:role-checked:manage, idn:role-unchecked:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `roleId` (path, required) — Parent Role Id of the dimensions.
- Body (application/json): dimensionbulkdeleterequest
- Returns 202: taskresultdto

### POST /roles/v1/{id}/access-model-metadata/{attributeKey}/values/{attributeValue}

`updateAttributeKeyAndValueToRoleV1` — Add a metadata to role.

This API initialize a request to add a single Access Model Metadata to a role by attribute key and attribute value. A token with ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN ROLE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call this API. The maximum number of attributes in one role is 25. Custom metadata update, including ADD and REPLACE need suit licensed.

- Scopes: idn:role-checked:update, idn:role:update
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The Id of a role
  - `attributeKey` (path, required) — Technical name of the Attribute.
  - `attributeValue` (path, required) — Technical name of the Attribute Value.
- Returns 200: role

### DELETE /roles/v1/{id}/access-model-metadata/{attributeKey}/values/{attributeValue}

`deleteMetadataFromRoleByKeyAndValueV1` — Remove a metadata from role.

This API initialize a request to remove a single Access Model Metadata from a role by attribute key and value. A token with ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN ROLE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call this API.

- Scopes: idn:role-checked:delete, idn:role-checked:update, idn:role:delete, idn:role:update
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The role's id.
  - `attributeKey` (path, required) — Technical name of the Attribute.
  - `attributeValue` (path, required) — Technical name of the Attribute Value.
- Returns 202: no body

### POST /roles/v1/access-model-metadata/bulk-update/ids

`updateRolesMetadataByIdsV1` — Bulk-update roles' metadata by id

This API initiates a bulk update of metadata for one or more Roles by a list of Role Ids. A token with ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN ROLE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call this API. The maximum role count in a single update request is 3000. The maximum metadata value count for a single role is 25. Custom metadata update, including add, replace need suit licensed.

- Scopes: idn:role-checked:update, idn:role:update
- Body (application/json): rolemetadatabulkupdatebyidrequest
- Returns 202: rolebulkupdateresponse

### POST /roles/v1/access-model-metadata/bulk-update/filter

`updateRolesMetadataByFilterV1` — Bulk-update roles' metadata by filters

This API initiates a bulk update of metadata for one or more Roles by filter. A token with ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN ROLE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call this API. The maximum metadata value count for a single role is 25. Custom metadata update, including add, replace need suit licensed.

- Scopes: idn:role-checked:update, idn:role:update
- Body (application/json): rolemetadatabulkupdatebyfilterrequest
- Returns 202: rolebulkupdateresponse

### POST /roles/v1/access-model-metadata/bulk-update/query

This API initiates a bulk update of metadata for one or more Roles by query. A token with ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN ROLE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call this API. The maximum metadata value count for a single role is 25. Custom metadata update, including add, replace need suit licensed.

- Scopes: idn:role-checked:update, idn:role:update
- Body (application/json): rolemetadatabulkupdatebyqueryrequest
- Returns 202: rolebulkupdateresponse

### GET /roles/v1/access-model-metadata/bulk-update/id

`getBulkUpdateStatusByIdV1` — Get bulk-update status by id

This API initial a request for one bulk update's status by bulk update Id returns the status of the bulk update process. A token with ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN ROLE_SUBADMIN authority is required to call this API.

- Scopes: idn:role-checked:update, idn:role:update
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The Id of the bulk update task.
- Returns 202: rolebulkupdateresponse

### GET /roles/v1/access-model-metadata/bulk-update

`getBulkUpdateStatusV1` — Get bulk-update statuses

This API returns a list of all unfinished bulk update process status of the tenant.

- Scopes: idn:role-checked:update, idn:role:update
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN
- Returns 200: array of rolegetallbulkupdateresponse

### POST /roles/v1/filter

`searchRolesByFilterV1` — Filter roles by metadata

This API returns a list of Role that filter by metadata and filter, it support filter by both path parameter and attribute key and values. A token with API, ORG_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN or SOURCE_ADMIN authority is required to call this API.

- Scopes: idn:role-unchecked:manage, idn:role-unchecked:read
- Parameters:
  - `for-subadmin` (query) — If provided, filters the returned list according to what is visible to the indicated ROLE_SUBADMIN Identity. The value of the parameter is either an Identity ID, or the special value **me**, which…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 50 — Max number of results to return See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — Boolean indicating whether a total count is returned, factoring in any filter parameters, in the X-Total-Count response header. The value is the total size of the collection that would be returned…
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: name, created, modified — e.g. `name,-modified`
  - `for-segment-ids` (query) — If present and not empty, additionally filters Roles to those which are assigned to the Segment(s) with the specified IDs. If segmentation is currently unavailable, specifying this parameter results…
  - `include-unsegmented` (query) — default True — Whether or not the response list should contain unsegmented Roles. If *for-segment-ids* is absent or empty, specifying *include-unsegmented* as false results in an error.
- Body (application/json): rolelistfilterdto
- Returns 200: array of role
